Chanakya University vs Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College for BCA follows the same pattern as their BBA comparison. Chanakya has the official fee. Jain College has a 2025 average, but no usable highest package in that row.

sections.heading: Chanakya University vs Sri Bhagawan Mahaveer Jain College for BCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Jain College if you want the only placement record on this page, from 2025, with an average of ₹4.92 lakh. The highest package in that row is recorded as zero, so we do not quote a highest figure.

Choose Chanakya University if you want an official 2026-27 fee. The university lists BCA Honors tuition of ₹1.60 lakh a year, a first-year payable fee of ₹1.65 lakh including registration, and a four-year programme total of ₹6.45 lakh. This page has no Chanakya BCA placement row.

sections.heading: Fees: official figures and what is missing
paragraphs: Chanakya University's official 2026-27 fee page lists BCA Honors as a four-year programme, with tuition of ₹1.60 lakh a year and a four-year total of ₹6.45 lakh. Our records still describe the listed BCA specialisations as three-year programmes, so confirm the current duration on the official admissions page.
Jain College has no BCA fee row on this page. Do not guess the fee. Get the college's current official notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Jain College's recorded 2025 average package is ₹4.92 lakh. The highest in that row is recorded as zero, so it is not used as a highest-package figure. Confirm that the official report is for BCA.
Chanakya University has no BCA placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. BCA admissions may use Class 12 marks, CUET, or a university test.
Read the current official admissions page of each institute for eligibility.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Chanakya University is listed at Devanahalli, on the Bengaluru outskirts. Jain College is listed at V.V. Puram.
Visit both if commute and lab facilities will decide the choice.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a 2025 average package on this page, Jain College is the side we can quote, at ₹4.92 lakh, but you must get its official fee and should not use a zero highest figure.

If you want an official 2026-27 fee, Chanakya University is the side we can quote, at ₹1.60 lakh tuition a year, but you must ask for a placement report and confirm the official four-year honours duration.
Do not invent a missing fee or a missing highest package.
